name: @arena/escalation-routing
description: Arena escalation routing — the capability-demand compiler and expert routing engine (Work Order C002; issue #76; spec/expert-escalation-api.md ES1.0 Routing). Compiles an EscalationRequest capability need into a versioned DemandProfile over the A004 capability graph, then routes over the ES1.0 routing inputs (qualified capabilities, demonstrated performance, current availability, historical task fit, geography/locale, required tools, conflict-of-interest rules, privacy clearance, budget, deadline) with typed machine-readable decisions and an append-only per-escalation decision history. Qualification is INPUT to ranking, never authorization (lock rule 9).
